facts.fact: Angola and Mozambique signed a memorandum of understanding covering communications, ICT, information and meteorology, with technical and institutional cooperation and exchange of expertise, on the sidelines of Mozambique's 5th National Communications Conference in Maputo; the article is dated 23 June 2026 and says Monday.
